facts.fact: Morocco's Interior Ministry, via the DGCT, announced an international tender for 29 May 2025 for a project including an information system to manage civil-status services and a central database connecting all civil-status offices, per Al Ahdath Al Maghribia as relayed by le360.

MAR.note: Real-time data exchange with other institutions is a stated aim of the civil-status project, not a platform built or procured.
Document says nothing on a data protection law.
Document says nothing on an ID number given at birth.
Document does not state a connection of local government offices.

facts.fact: The Interior Ministry, through the DGCT, runs the national project to digitise civil-status registers and set up a unified information system for 1,821 offices.
facts.system: Projet de numérisation des registres de l'état civil

facts.fact: A budget of over 194 million dirhams was allocated to the project, in five geographic lots, according to Al Ahdath Al Maghribia as relayed by le360.
